Which character did you like best?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Again?! AGAIN?! Did you not see that girl? Hannah was totally cute, and I was totally about to get her...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What did you say?!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh, I was just wondering how you managed to land a part in a Schlockspeare play given your remedial readings skills.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I can read! I even got, like, a 1550 on my Collegiate Aptitude Test!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, that may be true. But you're not reading this situation very well, are you? I mean, this girl is totally digging me, and you're not giving us any space.

nodes.text: Enough! You think you can just walk in here, bite your thumb at me, and then exeunt stage left with my ingenue! Well, you can't! And just so you know...

nodes.text: I took stage fighting at Edinburgh. En garde!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Huh?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hector, what... What did you just do to Jacob?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't worry, little lady. Mr. Hotpants assures me Jacob will wake in a few minutes with no memory of anything that just occurred.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Seriously...?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm always serious. Especially, when I say this... You're a lovely woman, Hannah, and someday you'll have a massive crush on $Matt and wish you'd given him your number.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wow... Okay! I mean, if you say so... Let me just get a pen and I'll write it on this program.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I said someday! Not today!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Nnhh... My aching head...

nodes.text: Come, $Matt! We must away!

nodes.text: Of course, we need to practice! The play goes on tomorrow!

nodes.text: So you're saying you've been putting off rehearsal until the last minute?

nodes.text: Hannah, you have your lines down cold, right?

nodes.text: Of course! I treat every night like opening night.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: But... But I do that too!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Jacob, please... If you were really serious about this play, you'd do something about those ridiculous tights the Costume Department has you wearing.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You think these tights are...? But...?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sorry, bro... You do kind of look like that elf, Leggylass.

nodes.text: Wow... I never realized how scared and insecure Jacob is. I'm embarrassed to admit this, but we were actually going out later.

nodes.text: No reason to ruin a perfectly good evening. If you're free, we could do something together.

nodes.text: Sure! How about I give you my phone number, and we'll...

nodes.text: NOooOOooOO!!!

nodes.text: Uh... You are?

nodes.text: But this is how the production was originally staged...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, but... What else could they do back then? From what I've read, Schlockspeare was all about catering to the masses.

nodes.text: This high-culture aesthetic is antithetical to the original intent.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You're suggesting that we should loosen up, let things get a little bawdier?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah! Why not?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ooh... Maybe we could have the clowns deliver their lines from seats in the audience!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Wow! This is a lot to think about. Maybe I should take down your phone number in case we have any additional questions.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Wait... You want me to give you my number?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah. Is that a problem?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: No, I just thought that I was... I mean, `Hannah` was supposed to give me her... Definitely not you...

nodes.text: And I really like your look! Very theatrical!

nodes.text: Okay, time to go to work!

Exhibit successful!

nodes.text: The technique we are now going to learn is something called `tranquilize.`

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Excellent! I've been itching for a chance to use Ol' Shotzilla on something other than rampaging bison.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Right... But instead of darts, we're going to `tranquilize` with words and body language.
nodes.text_bbcode: Right... But instead of darts, we're going to [color=#e23b3b][i]tranquilize[/i][/color] with words and body language.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The goal is simple. I want each of you to make `conversation` with a hottie... But this hottie must already be talking with another guy.
nodes.text_bbcode: The goal is simple. I want each of you to make [color=#e23b3b][i]conversation[/i][/color] with a hottie... But this hottie must already be talking with another guy.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You will then `tranquilize` your rival. But be warned... Go too far, and you might pick a fight. Play it too cool, and the girl might not recognize your interest.

nodes.text: Unfortunately, the other guy has a lot to offer, too. And chances are good that he's had more time to make his case.

nodes.text: The truth is... If you want to get enough time to demonstrate how great you are, you'll first need to open up a window of opportunity...

nodes.text: Yeah... I guess that makes sense.

nodes.text: So... You advocate being aggressive?

nodes.text: Yeah, but keeping it cool is important, too. Somehow, you have to do both.

nodes.text: It sounds pretty difficult to manage... Insulting someone while remaining above the fray of a real confrontation.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But it also sounds like a `plan.`

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Poke 'em in the eyes. That way they can't tell the police what you look like.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Eh... `No.` LoveBot?

nodes.text: I don't know... The only thing that makes me more nervous than girls is competing for girls with other guys. Uhh... Even thinking about it makes me naseous!

nodes.text: Wait! I'm rolling down the window!

nodes.speaker: LoveBot

nodes.text: Okay... So I guess that just leaves you, $Matt. What do you think you should do when confronted with a rival suitor?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, if you come on too strong, you'll seem like you're not in control of yourself. But if you don't engage, the girl will think you don't care enough to try.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I think you should...

nodes.text: Cool... Well, in that case, maybe I could get your number...?

nodes.text: Sure. Let me get a pen, and I'll...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: NoOOOoo!!!
Hector leaps out from behind a bookcase, seizes you by the collar, and drags you kicking and screaming from the library.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But... But the system worked! I was just about to get Angie's number!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Her number?! Her NUMBER?! Would you give a loaded gun to a chimpanzee? Would you give nuclear launch codes to a mustachioed madman?!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh... No?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Correct! You would never do any of those things!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And I would never allow a rank amateur to acquire anything as dangerous as a telephone number!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't know much about cheerleading. The truth is... I'm actually a bit of a wallflower.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Really? I never would've guessed.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Silly! No wonder you need help with your question! Ask away!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, Angie, what happened is this... Three years ago, a top-ranked cheerleading squad got stranded on a desert island...
Angie listens thoughtfully as you deliver the rest of the prompt.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's so interesting! You see, what you're talking about is actually an extension of game theory. The idea is that despite economic predictions of self-interest, non-cooperative behavior prevails in most real-world scenarios.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Here, that competitive behavior resulted in an unequal distribution of pom-poms.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Wow, that's... So unexpected! I thought for sure those girls would've started working with each other sooner or later.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Totally counter-intuitive, right? But that's life, never quite what you expect!
Conversation achieved!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: For instance, when you walked over here I thought for sure you were going to feed me some cheesy pick-up line, but talking to you has been really fun!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's the glasses, right? Because I wear glasses, you think I'm good at subjects like Chemistry?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: So... you're not?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No! I mean, yes, I am... But that's not the point! Why can't guys recognize that I'm more than my GPA?!
As the `conversation` hits an awkward pause, you look down at the card.
nodes.text_bbcode: As the [b]conversation[/b] hits an awkward pause, you look down at the card.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Wait... I wasn't supposed to ask you about 'real' chemistry homework. I was supposed to ask you if you ever felt like you had chemistry with someone you just met! So... Like, have you?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Seriously?! You're asking me that?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yes! I mean, no! I mean...
You glance back down at the card.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh, right! I'm asking for my friend over there. He and this girl he likes are starting to get serious and...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Wait a second! Are you reading off of a card?!
As you attempt to conceal the index card, Angie snatches it away from you. She starts reading over the text.
Several minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You know, the truth is... I'm not mad you tried to H.E.C.T.O.R. me like this.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You... You're not?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No, of course not. I understand wanting to get better at meeting possible romantic interests. I guess I'm just surprised. I mean, you're really cute. A guy like you should have absolutely no trouble approaching a girl like me.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You... You think I'm cute...?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, you could maybe use a new hairstyle, but... Yeah! For sure!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I really grok your look, by the way!

nodes.text: AAAAAAHHHH!!!

nodes.text: You... You could've killed us!

nodes.text: Sure, it's possible.

nodes.speaker: LoveBot

nodes.text: Just think about this... Compared to dying in a horrible traffic accident, working up the courage to talk to girls should be a walk in the park.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants

nodes.text: But the thing is, even with the right frame of mind, talking to girls can still be a challenge. This brings us to our next step... `Conversation.`

nodes.text: In order to make `conversation` with your prospective date, you'll first need to open with a playful and intriguing question.

nodes.text: You mean a 'pick-up line'?

nodes.text: Allow me to demonstrate! This script I'm about to use is entitled 'Broccoli Bedlam'. Watch closely!

nodes.text: Hey there!

nodes.text: Oh! Uh... Hi! Can I help you with something?

nodes.text: I hope so! You see, my friends and I have a disagreement, and we wanted to get your opinion. You see, my friend has this theory that all people can be divided into two categories, broccoli or asparagus.

nodes.text: Uh... Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! The idea is that Broccoli People tend to branch out in lots of directions. Meanwhile, Asparagus People tend to hone in on one thing.

nodes.speaker: Cute Redhead
nodes.text: Oh, I get it now! That's an interesting theory!
A few minutes later...

nodes.text: Which is why when you handed me your phone number, I could tell that you were into meeting new people and having new experiences!

nodes.speaker: Cute Redhead
nodes.text: Wow! I guess I really am a Broccoli Person! Catch you later, Hector!

nodes.text: $Matt, are you asking me out on a date?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... No other plans for the weekend then? I guess you don't get out very much. Weird. I thought you'd be more popular than that.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What?! No! I'm popular... I'm...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Really? Because it sounded like...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: No! No! I have lots of plans with lots of interesting people... Like mountain climbers and foreign dignitaries and the guy who played J.T. Raker on that old cop show!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You know all those people, and you still want to spend time with me?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yes...?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Saturday?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, well... Turns out there's this school play I need to check out on Friday, and I assist at the homeless shelter on Sunday...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh... You sound busy.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I know, right? But this film festival looks super cool so I'm making the time.
Good choice!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wow! Then I guess it must be good!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, so you can't go...?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: No... I'm afraid not. Like I said... Really busy.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, it sounds too interesting to miss. I think I'll call up some friends and check it out. Thanks for the tip, $Matt.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: No!!! Wait... Maybe I could fit it in after all!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But you just said...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I know what I said. But I just rearranged my schedule, so I'm available now. Really.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Then I remembered you were taking an Asian history class, and I decided to call you up. There are movies playing all weekend, and I'm...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh... That's right! You were the one wearing that totally ridiculous gold chain.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm sorry... Did you just say a name?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah! I'm $Matt. We met at the club.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh yeah! That's right! You're $Matt. We met at the club! You were wearing that awesome gold chain!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Dicussed what?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Don't you remember? The other night we were discussing how absurd it is that penguins look like they're wearing tuxedos.
Good choice!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If you made a big impression on a girl, you can afford to sit tight. If you didn't, you need to be prepared to call her sooner. Got it?

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Wow! That makes sense!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Yeah... And doing it that way will keep me from getting more trespassing convictions.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, glad to hear you're all on board. In a few days, we'll meet back up for the final step in getting a girl... The `Reconnect.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, glad to hear you're all on board. In a few days, we'll meet back up for the final step in getting a girl... The [color=#e23b3b][i]Reconnect.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A few days later, the group listens quietly as LoveBot calls the girl he met at the club.

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Sounds great. We'll meet at the arcade at seven. After that, we'll hit up `Weiner on a String` for chili dogs and lemonade.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds great. We'll meet at the arcade at seven. After that, we'll hit up [color=#e23b3b][i]Weiner on a String[/i][/color] for chili dogs and lemonade.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Excellent work, LoveBot! And I'm absolutely astounded that you managed to locate the one girl in North America better at videogames than you. Mr. Hotpants, you're next.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Nah, I'm just here to support you guys. The night after we went to the club, I found my girl breaking into my old man's garage.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh... I'm sorry to hear it didn't work out.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Are you kidding? It worked out great! Me and her are totally going out to grab dessert after the arraignment.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great... I think. Well, that just leaves you, $Matt. Are you ready to make the call?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah, I think so.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good. Now remember, there are a couple of tricks to `reconnecting` successfully. First, you'll need to smoothly remind her who you are. The best way is to continue your previous `conversation.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Good. Now remember, there are a couple of tricks to [color=#e23b3b][i]reconnecting[/i][/color] successfully. First, you'll need to smoothly remind her who you are. The best way is to continue your previous [color=#e23b3b][i]conversation.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Second, you'll need to make your time seem valuable. She should feel like you are busy, but working hard to fit her into your schedule.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Finally, don't ask her out. Everybody does that. You should make your suggestion to spend more time together in an intriguing or unusual way.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Wow! I hope I got all that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't worry, $Matt. You'll do fine. Now dial the digits you acquired.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Okay, here goes...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hi, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Three days? That seems like a good number, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah. Totally.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And in most situations, you won't seem overly desperate or overly disinterested.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah! That's what I was...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Wait... Most situations?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure, what if you only talked to a girl for five minutes before her friends dragged her back onto the dance floor? And then later on, you saw her talking to another guy?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Or what if you spent an entire evening talking to a girl and connected with her on a deeply spiritual level?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My point is... Any hard and fast rule will produce the wrong result some of the time. What you need to do is `evaluate` your encounter.
nodes.text_bbcode: My point is... Any hard and fast rule will produce the wrong result some of the time. What you need to do is [color=#e23b3b][i]evaluate[/i][/color] your encounter.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So it depends...? On what?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, I don't know... What if the girl you were talking to got distracted by her friends. I mean, if you don't call right away, she might forget who you are.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But what if you two really click? In that instance, you know she remembers you, so your goal is to enhance her sense of anticipation for your next encounter.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: I'm digging that!
Good answer!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You should be! $Matt is exactly right! It does `depend.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You should be! $Matt is exactly right! It does [color=#e23b3b][i]depend.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Sweet!

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Great! I can't wait to call the girl I met! I'm gonna do it right when I get home. Maybe I'll even call her several times in a row so she knows I care.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: You idiot! You `never` call a girl right away.
nodes.text_bbcode: You idiot! You [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] call a girl right away.

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: You don't?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: No! You always wait at least a week.

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: A week?! Why?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Because that's how long it takes to get everything together. I mean, first, you need to use a reverse directory to figure out her street address...

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Uh... Reverse directory?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Yeah. Then once you know where she lives, you call her from inside the upstairs bedroom when she's babysitting.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Mr. Hotpants, I'm not sure that's a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Why not?! I mean, it totally worked in that movie I saw! You know the one I'm talking about... 'When An Unfamiliar Person Telephones'.

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: Uh... Isn't that a horror movie?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: How would I know? I cut it off after ten minutes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $Matt, do me a favor and lay down the law on these jokers. When is the right time to call up a girl you've met?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, LoveBot does have a point. You need to demonstrate that you're interested. Otherwise, the girl might forget about you.

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Ha! I told you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But if you call too soon, you'll come off as desperate.

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That's why I think the answer is...
Later, on the ride home...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So how'd we do, fellas?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey, do you have a stick of gum, by any chance?
Item obtained!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh sure! Here!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey! This is the kind you can blow a bubble with!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Really...? I mean, I wouldn't know. I never was very good at blowing bubbles.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What?! Blowing bubbles is a life skill! Tell you what... You provide the gum, and I'll teach you how to blow a bubble.
Jessica pulls a few more pieces of gum from her purse.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Okay! I'm in! What do we do?
Fifteen minutes later, Jessica blows a beautiful bubble. It pops!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wow! I didn't know I could do that!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Guess I bring out the best in you. We should meet up some time, and see what else you and I can do together.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, I'd like that. And besides, you owe me a pack of gum.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Gimme five dollars!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What? Why?!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh... For the jukebox, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Seriously? I mean, I'm all for killer tunes, but why do you need my money? I saw you buy a soda earlier. You've got loads of cash on you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Did I say 'five dollars'? What I meant was... Could I borrow your sock? Or an earring? Whatever! Just gimme! GIMME!!!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Seriously, what's the matter with you, $Matt?! Let go of my shoe! Eeeek!!!
You wrestle Jessica's shoe off her foot.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Ha! Got it! I bet you totally want to give me your phone number now. I bet... Hey! Where are you going?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Eeeek!!!
Jessica races off. A few minutes later, Hector walks up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ouch! I'm guessing you asked for too much too quickly. Next time, remember to start smaller. Meanwhile, you'll need this for your next assignment.
Hector offers you a slip of paper.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh... This is a phone number?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Specifically, these are Jessica's digits. I told her you were my brother, you were in treatment for kleptoshoemania, and laid the guilt on extra thick. I think she'll take your call.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, at least I got a number.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I really dig your look! Very club chic!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Yeah, this wait could take hours.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Never fear, my studlings! Follow me!
Hector escorts your group to the front of the line.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Hector, my man... Looking sharp! These cats rolling with you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, Klaus. These are my boys.

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Did you see that? The bouncer knew Hector by name!

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: Shut up, LoveBot! Try to be cool!
The bouncer draws aside the velvet rope and ushers your group inside.

nodes.speaker: Bouncer
nodes.text: Gentlemen, step right in.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Whoa... Check it out. This club is fancy. No holes in the walls or nothing. You know what that means?

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: We don't have to worry about contracting any food-borne ailments?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Nah! It means fresh stalls to graffiti!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Cap that marker, son. This isn't a writing assignment, and penmanship doesn't count for squat.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Your mission is to put it all together. `Handle`, `exhibit`, `conversation`, `tranquilize...` And `obtain.` Do all of this well, and I can guarantee you'll go home with some digits. Now get out there!
nodes.text_bbcode: Your mission is to put it all together. [color=#e23b3b][i]Handle[/i][/color], [color=#e23b3b][i]exhibit[/i][/color], [color=#e23b3b][i]conversation[/i][/color], [color=#e23b3b][i]tranquilize...[/i][/color] And [color=#e23b3b][i]obtain.[/i][/color] Do all of this well, and I can guarantee you'll go home with some digits. Now get out there!

nodes.text: You step onto the dance floor and immediately notice a cute blonde. She stands with a group of friends.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Tee hee!
You cross to her, putting all your skills to work.
First, you drop your `handle.`
nodes.text_bbcode: First, you drop your [b]handle.[/b]

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hey there! I'm $Matt.
Handle approved!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wow! Killer name! I'm Jessica!
Then, you `exhibit` your cool look.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then, you [b]exhibit[/b] your cool look.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: So what do you think?
Exhibit successful!
Spud the Stud parks the Party Van in the parking lot of `The Centerscore Lounge.` The line to get in stretches around the block.
nodes.text_bbcode: Spud the Stud parks the Party Van in the parking lot of [b]The Centerscore Lounge.[/b] The line to get in stretches around the block.

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Can we even get in here?

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: So is that the next step? `'Invest'?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So is that the next step? [color=#e23b3b][i]'Invest'?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't be ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: But you just said...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know what I said, and the next step is to `Obtain... An investment.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know what I said, and the next step is to [color=#e23b3b][i]Obtain... An investment.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Okay, but shouldn't the step just be called...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: THE OTHER WAY WOULDN'T SPELL MY NAME!

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Wow. That was... Brutally honest.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ahem... As I was saying, gentlemen, we are now entering the big leagues. As such, I will be taking you to the hottest all-ages dance club in town.

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: You don't mean...?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: It can't be...?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: It is!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! There's a rich cultural history associated with offering presents to ladies. Flowers, candies, dinner...

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Just like I said! You agree with me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not so fast there, little guy.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This course is all about doing things differently! Which is why giving a girl something is usually the wrong thing to do. In fact, you want to do the exact opposite.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ideally, you'll convince the girl to offer `you` something... Anything. In fact, what it is doesn't matter! You simply want to encourage the girl to `invest` in you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ideally, you'll convince the girl to offer [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] something... Anything. In fact, what it is doesn't matter! You simply want to encourage the girl to [color=#e23b3b][i]invest[/i][/color] in you.

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: 'Invest'?! Like with stocks?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Exactly! You see... Whenever you invest in something, you hope to recoup your investment.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: So if a girl invests in me, she'll probably stick around long enough to 'turn a profit'!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Bold move! You've only just met this girl, and now you want her to give you something?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess so. But it doesn't have to be something tangible. It could be as simple as time or attention.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're absolutely right! But do you know why?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well, whenever a person invests in something, they hope to recoup their investment. If I could get the girl to invest in me...
Good answer!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Then she'll probably stick around long enough to 'turn a profit'!
As Spud the Stud drives the Party Van, Hector continues the lecture from his seat beside the wet bar.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So you've made `conversation` with a girl, and you've `tranquilized` the competition. What happens next?
nodes.text_bbcode: So you've made [color=#e23b3b][i]conversation[/i][/color] with a girl, and you've [color=#e23b3b][i]tranquilized[/i][/color] the competition. What happens next?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, I suppose one could buy this hypothetical lady a dessert.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sounds tasty. Mr. Hotpants, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Hotpants
nodes.text: Well... You could, like, get her to hand over her purse and then rifle through it for personal information.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... Just so we're clear, this class is about 'hooking up', not 'sticking up'.

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: A common mistake.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $Matt, your turn.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hmm... Both Mr. Hotpants and LoveBot are suggesting strategies for an exchange. Maybe the specifics are off, but I like the general idea.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I think maybe the next step is...

options.label: Try to get something from her.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good luck on your date, $Matt!
The next Saturday...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, $Matt! There you are! You ready for the movie?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Totally! And guess what? I have a surprise for you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You do? What is it?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Well... It turns out my dad went to college with the theater manager. Long story short, we'll be sitting in box seats tonight.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But aren't those usually closed to the public?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Usually, yes... Guess there are perks to rolling with $Matt.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I guess so!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Anyway, I... Um... I... I...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $Matt, is something the matter?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh no! I have no idea what I'm supposed to say next!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Uh... Would you mind going on in? I think I forgot something.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh... Okay. Sure.
As Jessica enters the theater, you cross to a nearby park bench. Hector and Spud the Stud have taken position there to 'watch you work'.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Congrats, $Matt! You're doing great!

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: Totally!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Great?! I'm tripping all over myself. What comes after the H, E, C, T, O, and R?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, that would be 'U'.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: 'U'...? Okay, what does 'U' stand for? Underwear? Ungulate? Uncomfortably long pause?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, it stands for `'YOU'.` As in 'all you'.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it stands for [color=#e23b3b][i]'YOU'.[/i][/color] As in 'all you'.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Me?! But what if I mess up or say the wrong thing? What if I totally blow it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You might. There's always that possibility. But the important thing to remember is that this girl likes you.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Really...? But everything I've said to her has been scripted.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Listen, $Matt. Sure, my scripts may have opened the door... But when the door opened, `you` were the one who walked through.
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, $Matt. Sure, my scripts may have opened the door... But when the door opened, [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] were the one who walked through.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Besides, you can't script life! Life just happens! Now go make it happen!
You look back to the theater. Through the window, you can see Jessica. She looks absolutely radiant and waves when she meets your gaze.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: You're right!
You return to Jessica and take her by the hand.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So who were you talking to back there?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Just a guy from this class I used to take.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Used to take? Did you drop out?

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Actually... I think I just `graduated!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually... I think I just [color=#e23b3b][i]graduated![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Aw... Now that was a pretty sweet ending, wasn't it? You mastered The H.E.C.T.O.R. Method, and you even got a cute girl!
Now it's time to take what you've learned here into the real world!
Let us know how you did by visiting the Surviving High School page on your favorite social networking site.
Later, as you exit the auditorium, Hector and Spud the Stud trade nervous glances. You're not sure why, but you feel that something nefarious is afoot.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Have fun on your date, $Matt.

nodes.speaker: Matt
nodes.text: Uh... Okay. Thanks.
The next Saturday...
You pace in front of the Art House Theater. Agitated, you check your watch for the tenth time.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: I don't get it. Jessica should be here by now.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $Matt, I'm afraid she won't be able to make it.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Hector! What are you doing here? And what happened to Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $Matt, when you began my course, I had high hopes for you... But just as some cows never learn to give chocolate milk, you've proven yourself incapable of interacting with women. As such, I've been forced to intervene.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Intervene?! With my date?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sadly, yes. According to Article 17, Bylaw 3 of The H.E.C.T.O.R. Method, Jessica has been assigned a new romantic interest.

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: What?! Who?!
Following Hector's indication, you turn to see a pleasant Italian restaurant. Inside, you see Jessica having dinner... With `LoveBot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Following Hector's indication, you turn to see a pleasant Italian restaurant. Inside, you see Jessica having dinner... With [b]LoveBot![/b]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: When Hector told me $Matt wasn't going to show up, I thought my night was over. But I've already had a better time tonight than I ever could've imagined!

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Indeed, female. Our romance is optimal!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I just love your silly robot-voice, LoveBot!

nodes.speaker: LoveBot
nodes.text: Beep beep!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: But... But... But...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And now, for the sake of hotties everywhere, you must be quarantined from all females for the rest of your natural life.
An unmarked, white van skids around the corner. Monks in crimson cloaks leap out from the vehicle, place a burlap sack over your head, and abduct you!
Though the language they speak is foreign, you know enough French to piece together their intent.
You will be taken to a pleasant monastery tucked away in the Belgian mountains. There, you will have much time to contemplate your abject failure with the ladies. Much... Much... Much time.
Several years later...

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: Oh, lovely day! The birds! The bees! Oh, I do so adore the Hautes Fagnes in the springtime!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: However... Despite my joy, I can't help feeling there is something missing from my life, something I once cared for very deeply. But... I cannot remember what that something was.
Looking out across the lake, you spy a pretty blonde in a canoe.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Tee hee!

nodes.speaker: You
nodes.text: That's it! `Women!` I'd forgotten all about them! How pretty they are! How sweet and cute and...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it! [color=#e23b3b][i]Women![/i][/color] I'd forgotten all about them! How pretty they are! How sweet and cute and...

nodes.text: You stiffen... And fall to the ground. Asleep!

A monk carrying `Ol' Shotzilla` emerges from the treeline. He frowns, shaking his head somberly from side to side. It seems you'll need more conditioning before you are again allowed to venture beyond the monastery gates.
nodes.text_bbcode: A monk carrying [b]Ol' Shotzilla[/b] emerges from the treeline. He frowns, shaking his head somberly from side to side. It seems you'll need more conditioning before you are again allowed to venture beyond the monastery gates.

nodes.text: Wow! Not only did you fail to learn Hector's techniques for meeting girls, you'll be spending the rest of your life in seclusion! Not cool!
Play again, and try for a better ending!

args.text: Surviving High School
